svg.title: OpenDART MCP · package design
svg.desc: An MCP client connects over local Streamable HTTP to MCPServer at /mcp. Pydantic settings configure its listener. The only registered tool is ping, which returns pong without an API key or network calls. The SDK is installed but not called. Docker builds a locked nonroot runtime; GitHub Actions checks, scans, signs and publishes images and audits published digests.
svg.text: packages/mcp · import opendart_mcp · native process or local Docker Compose service
Blue: tool requests / responses · Gray: settings · Dashed purple: container build and release flow
